hosts.description: The hosts of the environment the key runs on, instance i on the i-th.

publish.description: Host ports by port name, on one engine: the port the engine's host listens on for the container's.

name.description: The container's name instead of <installation>-<key>; a replica appends -<i>.

hostname.description: What the container calls itself; dotted, it is split as compose does and is the key's address.

aliases.description: More names on the installation's network.

ip.description: A fixed IPv4 address on the network (network.subnet holds it).

mounts.description: <source>:<target>[:<options>]: a host path (starting with /), or a volume of the installation the keys share, <volume>[/<subpath>].

restart.description: The engine's restart policy instead of the pack's.
